mapping.summary: CRM workspace in BC with pipeline board, customer 360, activities, targets and events.
claims: Works on BC's own contacts, opportunities, tasks and interactions
Sales dashboard with weighted pipeline, win rate, deal cycle, funnel and at-risk deals
Customer 360 view with balance, overdue, credit limit, orders, health score and churn flag
Drag-and-drop deal board that records stage changes in BC
Flags deals with no recent activity
Tasks, meetings and calls by overdue, today and this week, with a month calendar
Plans trade shows and events with budget and links resulting contacts and deals
Monthly salesperson targets, attainment, pipeline coverage and leaderboard
Eight daily automations create follow-up tasks and warnings
Logs customer email replies on the right contact and deal via Microsoft 365
Optional Azure OpenAI summaries, email drafts, chat assistant and business card scanning
Data stays in BC's own CRM tables
Online and on-premises from version 23, works in the BC mobile app
30-day trial for 3 users, then annual per-company licence for named users
